title: Synthetic claim/timeline tension interview (owner demo)
notes: Fully synthetic. Built so a careful interviewer might want clarification on time and place. Cues must remain probes—not verdicts.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Where were you between eight and ten on Friday night?

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: I was at the diner on Fifth the whole time. I got there at eight.

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: Just me. I sat at the counter.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: You mentioned earlier you met a friend.

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: Right—yeah, Sam came later. Maybe around nine.

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: Not long. We talked and I left.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: What time did you leave the diner?

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: I was gone by eight-thirty. Traffic was bad getting home.

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: I might have the times mixed up. It was a long day.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Where did you go after the diner?

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: Straight home. I already said that.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Earlier you said you were at the diner the whole time until ten.

turns.speaker: subject
turns.text: I meant I was out until ten. Part of it was the diner.
